title: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference to transform a simple…
content: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference to transform a simple untextured 3D white model (keeping the original movement/structure) into a fully reimagined scene with new style, textures, and environment.
tips: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference to transform a simple untextured 3D white model (keeping the original movement/structure) into a fully reimagined scene with new style, textures, and environment.

es.content: Usa Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference para transformar un modelo 3D blanco simple y sin texturas (manteniendo el movimiento/estructura original) en una escena completamente reinventada con un nuevo estilo, texturas y entorno.

fr.content: Utilisez Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference pour transformer un simple modèle 3D blanc sans texture (tout en conservant le mouvement/la structure d’origine) en une scène entièrement réimaginée, avec un nouveau style, de nouvelles textures et un nouvel environnement.

ja.content: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference を使用して、シンプルなテクスチャなしの3D白モデルを、元の動き／構造を維持したまま、新しいスタイル、テクスチャ、環境を備えた完全に再構築されたシーンへと変換します。

ko.content: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference를 사용하여, 단순한 텍스처 없는 3D 화이트 모델을 원래의 움직임/구조는 유지한 채 새로운 스타일, 텍스처, 환경을 갖춘 완전히 새롭게 재구성된 장면으로 변환하세요.

pt.content: Use o Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference para transformar um modelo 3D branco simples e sem textura (mantendo o movimento/estrutura original) em uma cena totalmente reinventada, com novo estilo, texturas e ambiente.

zh.content: 使用 Dreamina Seedance 2.5 White Model Reference，将一个简单的无纹理 3D 白模（保留原始动作/结构）转化为一个全新构想的场景，赋予其新的风格、纹理和环境。
